The '''Regency Worlds''', known also as the '''Arkanis Regency''', were a group of [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] that held economic control of trade along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] near its intersection with the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]], as well as [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]-dominated economics [[spinward]] of [[Kemal Station]]. Settled circa [[4200 BBY]] by pilgrims from the Core World of [[Ator/Legends|Ator]], few colonies in the region survived after communication with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ceased.

The Regency World systems were [[Arkanis/Legends|Arkanis]], [[Trulalis system|Issor]] (containing the worlds [[Issor]], [[Cadezia]], and [[Trulalis]]), [[New Ator]], [[Vasch]], and [[Huldamun]]. [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teeda]] once ruled the Regency Worlds.
